name: Adam Curry
abstract_title: T2: A NOVEL TEST FOR ASSESSING LATENT AWARENESS IN AI
abstract: We propose T2 (Turing 2), a novel test for assessing possible latent awareness in machines and AI. Current AI models can mimic intelligent interaction without any established basis for concluding that they are genuinely sentient, thus posing a central challenge in determining the extent of AI progress toward something like consciousness. authors: Adam Curry, Damon Abraham, Schahram Dustdar
field: Consciousness, psi research, global consciousness, AI and awareness
notable: Former researcher at Princeton PEAR Lab; MIT Ceres Connection Prize at age 17; founder of Entangled
